notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the third devlog for [i]Forged in Epic[/i]! Today, we’ll give you a brief introduction to the forging process, the second stage of weapon crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849556/62e5bef45f0a5d032b819ef55ebe63b30c83aaf6.gif[/img]

The current screen shows the forging phase, where cast metal is shaped to strengthen the weapon. A precisely forged weapon holds greater value, attracting more customer interest and commanding higher prices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849556/62503045d62c1303aa877c88a836d163a7ac955e.jpg[/img]

Please note that the showcased screen is still in development, and we plan to enhance its details and features further. We’re continuously working to improve interactive elements and graphics to heighten player immersion. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: DevLog #2
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the second devlog for [i]Forged in Epic[/i]! Today, we’ll be giving a brief overview of the core mechanics of the forging process, focusing on the first step: casting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849556/9be225567fdbacd9afd2f775d3283e7530ad2867.gif[/img]

To begin the casting process, you’ll need to add your chosen materials into the furnace and select a mold. Once that’s done, the casting begins when you start operating the bellows. Maintaining the furnace at the right temperature through precise bellowing is crucial. The quality of the final product is determined by how accurately you manage the process.

Please note that the screen shown is not yet final, and many more details and features will be added in the future. We’ll continue to enhance the interactions and graphics to create a more immersive experience, so stay tuned!

notes.title: DevLog #1
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the first devlog for our blacksmith management game! Today, we’ll give you a brief overview of the basic process of selling weapons to customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849556/fb1c76b40c670cc8e1e1faa42f7b082c14fb3cea.gif[/img]

The current screen shows the most basic form of various sales methods. When a customer enters the blacksmith shop, they request a specific weapon or equipment, and you choose the crafted item to sell to them. During this process, you’ll need to pay attention to the customer’s mood, as setting the right price can increase their satisfaction. If the customer is satisfied, the shop’s reputation will grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849556/0b6dcf4a057d45b06e4005fa809699d931273d1b.gif[/img]

Please note that the screen shown is not yet final, and many more details and features will be added in the future. We’ll continue to enhance the interactions and graphics to create a more immersive experience, so stay tuned!
